tournament_settings.value: Confirmed official visual reference: 12 teams (4 teams per group, 18 group matches total).

tournament_rules.title: Competition Format
tournament_rules.content: Three groups (Group A, Group B, Group C) of four teams each. Teams play against every other team in their group once (single round-robin). Win = 3 points, Draw = 1 point, Loss = 0 points.

tournament_rules.title: Knockout Matches & Shootouts
tournament_rules.content:
The knockout stage consists of Semi-final 1, Semi-final 2, Third-Place Match, and the Grand Final.
In the event of a draw at the end of regular time in any knockout match, the winner is determined immediately by a penalty shootout.

tournament_rules.title: Qualification to Knockout Stage
tournament_rules.content:
The group winners of Group A, Group B, and Group C automatically qualify for the semi-finals.
The fourth semi-finalist is the best second-place team across all three groups based on points, goal difference, and goals scored.

tournament_rules.title: Roster & Discipline Rules
tournament_rules.content:
Each team consists of an official roster of 7 players. A player cannot register or play for two different teams.
Any team arriving more than 10 minutes past scheduled kickoff loses by forfeit (3-0).
Respect towards referees, opposing players, and fair play is strictly mandatory.

tournament_rules.title: Tie-Breaking Rules
tournament_rules.content:
In case two or more teams finish with equal points:
1. Head-to-head match result between tied teams.
2. Overall goal difference.
3. Overall goals scored.

tournament_awards.subtitle: Tournament Kingpin Award
